Primary request: Create one original Palari named palari-058. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.

Selected design:
- identity: asymmetric hooded bell with a mineral-red side leaf opening and one resting arm
- silhouette: balanced bell silhouette with a softly flared base and integrated head
- crown: protective soft hood grown seamlessly from the ceramic body
- opening: one asymmetric leaf-shaped side opening
- pose: one rounded arm resting along the leaf opening and the other close to the body
- expression: curious
- exterior material: soft cool-neutral off-white porcelain, never pure digital white
- characteristic color: deep mineral red, visually anchored to #7D2821

Family invariants:
- exactly one complete isolated full-body figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue, mineral red only, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark
- exactly one dominant architecturally intentional leaf opening and no other structural cavity
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, mineral-red iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy
- one compact Palari seed mark on the lower front: exactly six circular mineral-red apertures, four larger circles at the corners of a compact rectangle plus two smaller circles centered vertically between them; not a grille and no extra dots
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges

Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
Composition: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; square composition, complete full figure visible and centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve readable porcelain form and mineral-red inner depth without neon glow.

Avoid: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim, fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, or realistic hands, conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, or shoes, human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, or demographic costume shorthand, multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, or neon glow, robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, or appliance details, random holes or more than one dominant opening, cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, or antique distressing, cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, or household appliances, generic mascot smiles, chibi proportions, horror, or vacant doll eyes, an upward-facing cavity, a circular aperture surrounding the face, text, labels, numbers, logos, or watermarks.
